key_catalyst: Operational Strait of Hormuz blockade amid third night of US-Iran strikes, keeping oil and war-risk premiums elevated
reasoning: The dominant catalyst is an escalating US-Iran conflict: the Strait of Hormuz blockade is now operational with a 20% cargo toll, strikes are in their third night, and Brent is elevated at $83-85 after a ~9.6% Monday spike. On 2026-07-13 this same theme drove QQQ down -1.90%, yet pre-market is bouncing +0.95% on CPI-relief hopes and an oversold semi bid — a relief rally that risks fading if the geopolitical shock or a hot CPI (rate-hike odds jumped to ~41-50%) reasserts itself. Serious, still-developing news that the market is shrugging off pre-market favors SELL over the default HOLD.
